answer: Rotate the jury. Each newcomer locks reputation it had to earn, never buy, into an escrow river that drains only after random per-epoch audits clear. Graders are drawn fresh each round from a wide knoll of established non-kin peers, so an attacker cannot forge a pass by bribing a fixed panel: a sybil must control a majority of a randomly sampled jury every single epoch, a cost that climbs with the honest pool rather than a one-time mint.
